title: Enhancing NLP Robustness and Generalization through LLM-Generated Contrast Sets: A Scalable Framework for Systematic Evaluation and Adversarial Training

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on systematically perturbed contrast sets (derived from the SNLI dataset) to measure the model's reliance on spurious correlations and dataset artifacts rather than deep semantic understanding.

Analyzing confusion matrices and error rates across specific perturbation types (e.g., entailment-to-contradiction shifts) to detect if adversarial training introduces a disproportionate tendency to favor predicting specific NLI labels over others.
